title: bamboo silk plants
text: bamboo silk plants. Bought these to go with a buddha fountain I purchased... set them in a barrel planter I purchased.  They look great.  Sort of real.. ha.  They did a good job incorporating some "sticks" at the bottom that sort of look like new shoots without leaves in a way.  Using them in Arizona so I don't have to water.  The ones I received did NOT have leaves down as far as they show in the photo... they leaves start about 2 feet up from the pot.  Which is weighted - some - but very small pots.  Over all, I am pleased.
